verification_report.summary: Correct. The terminal report assembles the verified stage-3 facts within their actual scopes: v2 is dissipative but not perfectly matched at a planar constant x-PML interface; the standard stretched-coordinate Maxwell-Debye model restores continuous planar-interface matching while preserving the physical Debye law; the only verified monotone energy for the stretched repair is the reduced normal-incidence 1D identity, while the full 2D ADE physical-energy calculation has sign-indefinite memory couplings and is explicitly left as an augmented/passive-memory gap. Older verified facts support the old eight-variable edge-mode obstruction, the Gronwall fallback context, and the v2 monotone absorbing-layer identity. The fractional and MPML discussions are classified as status/context and do not overclaim a theorem. External reference checks support the load-bearing literature uses: Joly for impedance/stretched-coordinate PML matching, Baffet et al. for non-naive constant-coefficient augmented energies, Bécache-Kachanovska-Wess for Laplace-domain dispersive PMLs with material laws retained, and Xie/Ping/Meza-Fajardo-Papageorgiou for MPML as stability-oriented with possible loss of exact matching.
